method.name: multiformat_bounded_serial_anchors_v1
method.assumptions: Conditional on selected 500-card non-autograph numbered base tiers substantially reaching the listed formats at their nominal serial ceilings. Format packs are nonnegative; 3% anchor tolerance defines sensitivity ranges, not confidence intervals. Retail SE/EA split remains unidentified; only aggregates supported across all feasible mixes are published. Identical repeated source rows are counted once. One-of-ones and autographs do not calibrate production.
